configuration.weights_scenarios: 1/5 within each mode; no cross-mode pooled conclusion

planner.information: technical catalog and observed IDs; hypothetical draws independent of real order

configuration.commitments: maximize worst utility in current state and no-new-decisions projection up to 3 future turns, truncated at 20
configuration.myopic: maximize utility after immediate vector, ignoring pending payments
configuration.conservative: maximize (survival this turn, weakest bar after immediate + due, utility)
configuration.signs: maximize sum(sign(immediate component)/current bar); no exact magnitude or future
configuration.terminal_states: keep raw nonpositive component, cap others to 100; stop at defeat, do not extrapolate to turn 20
configuration.intervals: Wilson 95% per cell; paired normal approximation for win differences; no multiplicity correction
configuration.sensitivity: same seeds; no modified catalog; hypothetical initial bars +-5 and myopic min weight 0 or .15
